title: Cluster Health
description: Per-cluster container and resource metrics. Used for capacity planning and cross-cluster comparison.

panels.title: Running Containers per Cluster
panels.description: Docker containers running in each cluster over the selected time range

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  cluster,
  docker_running
FROM boss_heartbeats
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Disk Usage per Cluster (Latest)
panels.description: Current disk usage percentage per cluster, from the most recent heartbeat

targets.query:
SELECT
  cluster,
  argMax(disk_used_pct, timestamp) AS disk_pct
FROM boss_heartbeats
WHERE timestamp > now() - 120
GROUP BY cluster

panels.title: Container Count: Running vs Total
panels.description: Running vs total Docker containers per cluster, stacked view

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  cluster,
  docker_running
FROM boss_heartbeats
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  timestamp,
  cluster,
  docker_total
FROM boss_heartbeats
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Memory Usage per Cluster
panels.description: Memory usage percentage per cluster over time

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  cluster,
  mem_used_pct
FROM boss_heartbeats
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: System Load (1m) per Cluster
panels.description: System load average per cluster over time

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  cluster,
  load_1m
FROM boss_heartbeats
ORDER BY timestamp
